projects.title: Blutec Ping
projects.desc: Optimized backend for a bulk WhatsApp messaging service. Integrated the WhatsApp API for high-volume queues and streamlined queries for large-scale broadcasts.
projects.overview: Ping by Blutec is a production WhatsApp marketing platform built on the official WhatsApp Business API — broadcast to thousands, let AI answer the replies, and surface the leads worth calling. I optimized the bulk-messaging backend and high-volume send queues so campaigns of 10,000+ contacts deliver reliably under WhatsApp's rate limits.
features: Bulk broadcasts to 10,000+ contacts per campaign with rate limits handled automatically
AI chatbots that answer incoming replies in seconds, around the clock
Lead and engagement scoring that routes qualified contacts to the sales team
Shared team inbox with agent assignment and internal notes
Approved-template campaigns with audience segmentation and personalisation variables
Delivery, read, reply and click analytics for every campaign

The site presents the firm's practice areas, global reach and credibility, and routes every enquiry into an internal lead system — backed by automation workflows that connect prospective clients with the right team member fast.

Lead-capture and enquiry workflows feeding an internal lead-management system
Admin panel for the team to manage enquiries and site content
Credibility sections — 25,000+ marks registered, 30,000+ clients, 111+ countries, testimonials
Fast, responsive Next.js frontend with 'Schedule a Consultation' conversion flows
Automation that routes incoming leads to the right team member

projects.title: AI-Powered OCR Pipeline
projects.desc: Converts unstructured PDFs and itineraries into database-ready JSON. Combines OpenAI, Mistral AI, AWS, Azure, MinerU and OCR, syncing to Directus — cutting manual entry 80%+.
projects.overview: A multi-format document-analysis engine that benchmarks cloud OCR services on real documents — PDFs, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, CSV and plain text — then scores extraction quality and maps exactly where each engine fails. Built as a production proof-of-concept at 7Span to choose the most accurate, lowest-cost OCR stack for automating manual data entry.
features: Dual-engine comparison — Azure Document Intelligence vs MinerU Cloud on identical inputs
Multi-format parsing (PDF, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, CSV, TXT) with automatic format detection
Document-structure detection: multi-column reordering, invoice grouping, table preservation
Accuracy metrics — similarity %, character/word accuracy, CER and WER (Levenshtein)
Character and word confusion maps that show precisely how each engine misreads
Dual-format baseline output (TXT + Markdown) plus structured JSON reports per document

projects.desc: A Google Maps B2B lead-generation tool streamlining automated business-data extraction, prospect discovery and client outreach.

projects.title: Enterprise ETL & Denormalization
projects.desc: Merged 30+ tables across 8-10 databases and 15M+ records into one source of truth. A Python ETL syncs daily inserts and improved retrieval ~60%.

projects.title: Multi-Model Content Automation
projects.desc: A task-handoff pipeline orchestrating Storyteller, Architect and Editor LLM roles, enforcing GEO and human-touch formatting without manual prompting.
projects.overview: An LLM task-handoff pipeline that splits content creation across three specialised roles — Storyteller, Architect and Editor — so each model does one job well. The chain enforces GEO (generative-engine optimization) structure and a human-touch formatting pass automatically, removing the manual prompt-chaining between steps.
features: Three-role LLM orchestration — Storyteller drafts, Architect structures, Editor refines
Automatic GEO formatting so output is tuned for AI answer engines
Human-touch pass that strips the robotic tone from generated copy
Zero manual prompt-chaining — each role hands off to the next programmatically
Delivered as a reproducible Jupyter pipeline

projects.title: Inshorts News Scraper
projects.desc: Scrapes daily trending domain-specific news from Inshorts and organizes it via Google Sheets API every morning — saving 2+ research hours a day.
projects.overview: A Python automation that scrapes trending, domain-specific news from Inshorts every morning and files it straight into Google Sheets — turning a daily 2+ hour manual research routine into a scheduled, hands-off job.
features: Scrapes category-specific trending news from Inshorts on a daily schedule
BeautifulSoup + Selenium handling for dynamically rendered content
Writes clean, structured rows to Google Sheets via the Sheets API
Runs every morning unattended — saves 2+ research hours a day
Single-file, low-dependency script that is easy to redeploy

projects.title: Generative AI Fine-Tuning
projects.desc: Fine-tuned Meta Llama 3.1 8B with Unsloth and QLoRA on dual T4 GPUs. Built an ingestion pipeline over 40,000+ MongoDB articles for content generation.

projects.title: X AI Automation Bot
projects.desc: A Python pipeline using free-tier LLM APIs to generate context-aware content and autonomously publish scheduled posts to X.
projects.overview: An autonomous social bot that generates context-aware posts with free-tier LLMs and publishes them to X on a schedule — no paid API tier required. Several model backends (Google Gemini, Mistral AI, OpenRouter) are wired in so it keeps running even when one free quota runs dry.
features: Context-aware post generation from a maintained topic/queue file
Multi-backend LLMs — Google Gemini, Mistral AI and OpenRouter, all free-tier
Autonomous scheduled publishing to X via the X API
Provider fallback so a single rate-limit never stops the pipeline
Pure-Python, lightweight and self-hostable

projects.title: Developer Portfolio
projects.desc: A responsive personal portfolio presenting development, data-engineering and AI work through a structured, JSON-driven content system.
projects.overview: This site. A fully JSON-driven personal portfolio built on the latest Next.js, presenting full-stack, data-engineering and AI work through one structured content system — edit the data and the whole site updates. Hand-built neo-brutalist design with a pure-CSS dark mode and generated social images.
features: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack) + React 19 + TypeScript strict
Tailwind CSS v4 with a token-driven neo-brutalist design system
Single JSON content layer — every page and section reads from src/data
Pure-CSS dark mode via data-theme tokens, with no flash on load
Auto-generated Open Graph / Twitter social images using next/og
Per-page SEO metadata, sitemap, robots and JSON-LD Person schema
